method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a completely blank grid - every one of the ~40 ruled data rows is empty; the printed TOTAL cell carries a slashed-zero glyph (a circled/oval 0 struck through by a long horizontal stroke), read as 0 per the zero-glyph ruling and confirmed in a 600 dpi cell crop. Cover line 1 prints a handwritten 0 in ALL THREE columns (LAST 0 + THIS 0 = CUM 0), and cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is likewise 0 in all three, so there is no small-donor aggregate hiding anything. Rows sum 0.00 = schedule total 0 = both cover cells; the two scopes coincide at zero, recorded as cumulative.

expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) is a completely blank grid; its printed TOTAL cell carries the same slashed-zero glyph (confirmed at 600 dpi), i.e. 0. That equals the cover's THIS REPORT expense cell (0) and NOT the CUMULATIVE cell (571.00), which is the scope test firing cleanly: this filer's schedule is PER-PERIOD, not cycle-to-date. The 571.00 cumulative was itemized on an earlier filing that is not in this PDF. Zero rows here is a real per-period zero, not a gap.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows sum 0.00 = printed TOTAL 0 (slashed-zero glyph); p3 rows sum 0.00 = printed TOTAL 0 (slashed-zero glyph). Both gates fire.
gates.row_count: p2 and p3 are ruled ~40-row grids with ZERO inked data rows (verified on the full 200 dpi page read of each); 0 rows emitted per side. rowbands not needed for a wholly blank grid.
gates.geometry_proof: not applicable - zero rows emitted on either side, so no row geometry is claimed.
gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly on both columns. THIS column: contributions 0 - expenses 0 = 0 change; cover balance LAST -571.00 + 0 = THIS-column balance figure. CUMULATIVE column: contributions 0 - expenses 571.00 = -571.00 = cover line 4 cumulative -571.00. The filer carries a negative (self-funded/unreimbursed) balance and states it consistently.

escalation_note: 600 dpi cell crops of the p2 and p3 TOTAL cells to settle the total glyph: both render an oval zero struck by a long horizontal stroke (a slashed/nil zero), not a numeral 6 or 0-dash.
